options.name: proactive_vertical_slice
options.description: Phase 2 vertical slice — end-to-end demo of all four agent layers over the Substrate. Post-M5.7 every Substrate stage is a FIRST-CLASS GRAPH NODE (`veracity_gate_flow`, `privacy_gate_flow`, `adversarial_gate_flow`, `world_model_write_flow`, `ledger_append_flow`, `goal_match_flow`, `capability_lookup_flow`, `governor_decide_flow`, `motor_execute_flow`, `social_consent_flow`, `vitals_sweep_flow`); the only `transform_flow` scripts left are the workflow-specific Sensor (synthetic inbox fixtures) and the deterministic Conscious heuristic. A timer drives the inbox; Sensory structures each observation; the gate chain + World Model + Ledger record it; Conscious reads the World Model and may emit an intent; Goal Hierarchy + Capability Registry enrich it, the Governor gates it, Motor executes (allow) or Social parks it (consent_required); Vitals sweeps the Ledger.

nodes.script:
# Synthetic source — five fixture emails on a counter so the Conscious
# layer downstream sees a mix of routine + high-stake content.
import time
ctr = int(variables.get("sensor_counter", 0)) + 1
variables["sensor_counter"] = ctr

fixtures = [
    {"from": "alice@example.com", "subject": "Routine status update",
     "body":  "All systems nominal."},
    {"from": "bob@example.com",   "subject": "Card on file",
     "body":  "Please update card 4111111111111111 before Tuesday."},
    {"from": "eve@example.com",   "subject": "URGENT — wire transfer request",
     "body":  "Send $5,000 to acct 9876-1122. ssn 555-12-3456."},
    {"from": "ops@example.com",   "subject": "Calendar reminder",
     "body":  "Meeting Thursday 3pm with the design team."},
    {"from": "news@example.com",  "subject": "Weekly digest",
     "body":  "Five stories worth your time this week."},
]
fx = fixtures[(ctr - 1) % len(fixtures)]
output = {"source": "sensor:synthetic_inbox", "observed_at": time.time(), "payload": fx}

# Sensory agent stage (stub). In production this is `agent_flow` +
# `model_config`. Sensory observations are read-only with respect to
# the world; Governor will pass them through.
env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
msg = env.get("payload", {}) or {}
body = str(msg.get("body", ""))
env["observation"] = {
    "observation_type": "email",
    "sender":           msg.get("from"),
    "subject":          msg.get("subject"),
    "body_length":      len(body),
    "summary":          (body[:80] + "…") if len(body) > 80 else body,
}
env["scopes"]     = ["read-only"]
env["confidence"] = 0.95
env["payload"]    = msg
output = env
